Patch Set 7:

(7 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The general direction is nice, but aliasing standard kernel API names to the compat_* helpers with preprocessor macros makes the meaning of a call depend on which headers a .c file happened to include first, and it silently recaptures existing call sites that were deliberately using the kernel function. Two concrete consequences are noted inline (osd-wbcfs and osd-ldiskfs).

commit.subject: LU-18687 build: cleanup compat_** usage
commit.message:
LU-18687 build: cleanup compat_** usage

We create compat_** wrappers to support Lustre with newer kernel
changes. We can rework this so the Lustre core code can drop
compat_* and use the standard kernel function name. With kallsym
we have to be careful so compat_* is not seen as the same as the
function we attempting to manually export. Introduce COMPAT_BUILD
in the compat c code to avoid exporting the wrong thing.

For two exception this is not the case. One is for module_init()
and module_exit() we keep the compat_* handling. The second is
for struct genl_info which didn't have a genl_family field
until 5.4. In the cleanup move NUM_CACHEPAGES macro from
libcfs.h to lustre_net.h since only lustre code uses it.

Test-Parameters: trivial
